market_context: The Nasdaq-100 fell 0.64% to 26,046.90 (QQQ -0.65% to $633.93) after recovering from a steep early drop, as hotter October core PCE inflation (3.3% vs 3.2% expected), new 20% tariff proposals, and a continued AI-stock pullback weighed on tech; the PHLX Semiconductor Index closed down 0.65% after falling as much as 8% early, the Nasdaq Composite lost 0.62% to 23,585.80 and the S&P 500 0.25% to 7,182.78, while the Dow rose 0.33% to 50,182.95.
market_cap_basis: Shares outstanding x 2026-11-25 close. Shares implied from Nasdaq market caps as of the 2026-10-29 close (watchlist market_cap_usd / 2026-10-29 close), so multi-class companies (e.g. GOOGL) reflect all share classes.

stocks.name: Analog Devices Inc. Common Stock
stocks.reason: Analog Devices bounced a day after plunging 17.4% on disappointing fiscal first-quarter EPS guidance. BMO Capital reiterated its Outperform rating and $430 price target, while Truist cut its target to $323 from $405 and kept a Hold, and Bank of America lowered its target to $425 from $500 but kept a Buy, calling Tuesday's drop an overreaction.

sources.title: BMO Capital reiterates ADI stock Outperform on mid-cycle recovery
Truist cuts Analog Devices stock price target to $323 on cyclical peak signals
Analog Devices price target lowered to $425 from $500 at BofA

stocks.name: Lam Research Corporation Common Stock
stocks.reason: Lam Research fell as investors focused on reports that lawmakers may attach the MATCH Act, which would tighten chip-equipment export controls on China, to the FY2027 defense bill. China accounted for 35% of Lam's September-quarter revenue, the highest exposure among the large U.S. toolmakers.

stocks.name: Texas Instruments Incorporated Common Stock
stocks.reason: Texas Instruments had no company-specific news of its own; the shares bounced 4.5% with analog peer Analog Devices after Tuesday's 11.2% drop, even as the PHLX Semiconductor Index finished slightly lower.

stocks.name: Micron Technology Inc. Common Stock
stocks.reason: Micron fell further as Tuesday's BNP Paribas downgrade — Neutral from Outperform, with Karl Ackerman cutting the price target to $775 from $1,700 — continued to weigh, alongside weaker 2027–28 memory-pricing forecasts. Goldman Sachs had earlier in the week cut its 2028 DRAM and NAND price forecasts by about 20%, and TrendForce lowered its 2027 DRAM contract-price outlook.

stocks.name: NVIDIA Corporation Common Stock
stocks.reason: Nvidia dropped as Monday's rally on Jensen Huang's reinstatement faded and investors sold AI-linked stocks on hotter October PCE inflation, new 20% tariff proposals, and renewed doubts about AI spending and returns. The shares recovered from a steeper early decline to close down 3.9%.

sources.title: Nvidia leads tech sell-off as Huang comeback rally fizzles

stocks.name: Applied Materials Inc. Common Stock
stocks.reason: Applied Materials fell with other chip-equipment names on fears the MATCH Act could further restrict tool sales to China, which accounted for 28% of revenue in the first nine months of fiscal 2026. UBS analyst Timothy Arcuri cut his price target to $575 from $640 and kept a Buy rating.

stocks.name: Meta Platforms Inc. Class A Common Stock
stocks.reason: Meta rose even as most other mega-cap tech stocks fell. Fortune reported that Amazon and Meta are in talks to lift a blockade on Meta's Muse shopping agent, and Bloomberg reported that CoreWeave's banks are preparing a $4.5 billion GPU-backed loan tied to a Meta data-center contract in Georgia.

sources.title: Amazon and Meta reportedly in talks to lift blockade on AI agent Muse

stocks.name: Amazon.com Inc. Common Stock
stocks.reason: Amazon fell as investors focused on the cost of its AI build-out — trailing capital spending of about $215 billion and negative free cash flow — and Bernstein flagged that AWS usage metrics were running about 16% below third-quarter levels, which it said could slow first-quarter 2027 revenue growth.
